Shrinkage is a Rust library for fitting regression models with penalties that
shrink coefficients, select features, or encourage structure. It supports
linear, logistic, and multivariate regression, with lasso, ridge, elastic net,
SLOPE, Group LASSO, and fusion penalties.

The library combines losses, penalties, and solvers through a typed API. It
supports dense and sparse matrices through LazyMatrix and fits regularization
paths by reusing previous solutions. Python bindings provide dense Gaussian
lasso fitting, prediction, and convergence diagnostics and are under
development.
